_note: Descriptions of the eight cognitive functions and the four preference pairs. Original text, CC BY-SA 4.0.

zh-CN.name: 外倾感觉
zh-CN.short: 沉浸当下，敏锐感知并即时行动
zh-CN.description: 关注此时此地的具体感官信息，喜欢直接体验、随机应变，能迅速对环境变化做出反应。
examples: 在突发状况中迅速采取行动
很享受美食、运动、音乐等直接的体验

en.name: Extraverted Sensing
en.short: Absorbed in the present; perceives keenly and acts on the spot
en.description: Focuses on concrete sensory information here and now, enjoys direct experience and improvising, and responds quickly to changes around them.
examples: Acts quickly when something unexpected happens
Enjoys direct experiences like good food, sports or music

zh-CN.name: 内倾感觉
zh-CN.short: 参照过往经验，重视熟悉与稳定
zh-CN.description: 把当下的经验与记忆中的细节对照，留意事物与过去的差别，重视可靠、熟悉和身体的感受。
examples: 遇到新情况时自然地对比以前的经历
保持稳定的习惯和惯例让自己安心

en.name: Introverted Sensing
en.short: Draws on past experience; values the familiar and stable
en.description: Compares present experience with remembered details, notices how things differ from before, and values reliability, familiarity and bodily sensations.
examples: Naturally compares a new situation with past ones
Feels settled by keeping steady habits and routines

zh-CN.name: 外倾直觉
zh-CN.short: 发散联想，看见各种可能
zh-CN.description: 在外部世界中不断发现新的联系和可能性，喜欢头脑风暴、跨领域联想和尝试新方向。
examples: 讨论时点子一个接一个地冒出来
看到问题时也看到其中的机会

en.name: Extraverted Intuition
en.description: Keeps discovering new connections and possibilities in the outside world; enjoys brainstorming, cross-domain associations and new directions.
examples: Ideas keep popping up during discussions
Sees opportunities inside problems

zh-CN.name: 内倾直觉
zh-CN.short: 汇聚洞察，看见长远方向
zh-CN.description: 把大量信息在内心整合成一个核心的洞见或长远图景，常有“突然想通”的时刻，关注事物的本质和走向。
examples: 从复杂信息中提炼出一个关键结论
心里有一个长远目标，做事都围绕它展开

en.name: Introverted Intuition
en.short: Converges on insight; sees the long-term direction
en.description: Integrates much information inwardly into a core insight or long-range picture, often with sudden "click" moments; attends to essence and trajectory.
examples: Distills one key conclusion from complex information
Keeps a long-term goal in mind and arranges work around it

zh-CN.name: 外倾思考
zh-CN.short: 组织资源，追求效率和结果
zh-CN.description: 用外部的标准、数据和流程来组织事情，重视效率、可衡量的目标和实际成果，善于决策和推动执行。
examples: 把杂乱的任务整理成计划并分配
用是否有效来判断一个方法

en.name: Extraverted Thinking
en.short: Organizes resources; pursues efficiency and results
en.description: Organizes things with external standards, data and processes; values efficiency, measurable goals and real outcomes; decides and drives execution well.
examples: Turns a jumble of tasks into an assigned plan
Judges a method by whether it works

zh-CN.name: 内倾思考
zh-CN.short: 构建内在逻辑，追求精确与自洽
zh-CN.description: 在内心建立一套自洽的逻辑框架，追求定义精确、原理清楚，善于拆解问题、发现矛盾。
examples: 一定要弄明白事物运作的原理
很快发现论证中的漏洞

en.name: Introverted Thinking
en.short: Builds inner logic; seeks precision and consistency
en.description: Builds a self-consistent logical framework inside, seeks precise definitions and clear principles, and is good at breaking problems down and spotting contradictions.
examples: Needs to understand the principle behind how things work
Quickly spots gaps in an argument

zh-CN.name: 外倾情感
zh-CN.short: 协调人际，营造和谐氛围
zh-CN.description: 关注群体的情绪和需要，自然地调整言行让大家舒适，重视礼节、共识和人与人之间的连接。
examples: 很快察觉到一群人中的气氛变化
主动照顾被冷落的人

en.name: Extraverted Feeling
en.short: Harmonizes relationships; creates a good atmosphere
en.description: Attends to the group's feelings and needs, naturally adjusts words and actions to put people at ease, and values courtesy, consensus and connection.
examples: Quickly notices shifts in a group's mood
Reaches out to someone left out

zh-CN.name: 内倾情感
zh-CN.short: 忠于内心价值，追求真实
zh-CN.description: 依据内心深处的价值观做判断，重视真诚、个性和意义，对自己细微的情绪变化很敏感。
examples: 不愿做违背自己内心的事
即使大多数人同意，也会坚持自己的判断

en.name: Introverted Feeling
en.short: True to inner values; seeks authenticity
en.description: Judges by deeply held personal values, cares about sincerity, individuality and meaning, and is sensitive to subtle shifts in own feelings.
examples: Won't do things that go against conscience
Holds to own judgment even when most people disagree

first.name: 外向
first.description: 更多从与人互动和外部活动中获得能量，倾向于边做边想、边说边想。

second.name: 内向
second.description: 更多从独处和内在思考中恢复能量，倾向于想清楚再表达。

first.name: Extraversion
first.description: Draws energy more from interaction and outside activity; tends to think while doing and talking.

second.name: Introversion
second.description: Recharges more through solitude and inner reflection; tends to think before speaking.

first.name: 实感
first.description: 更关注具体、现实、可验证的信息，重视经验和细节。

second.name: 直觉
second.description: 更关注模式、意义和可能性，喜欢想象和整体把握。

first.name: Sensing
first.description: Pays more attention to concrete, real, verifiable information; values experience and detail.

second.name: Intuition
second.description: Pays more attention to patterns, meaning and possibilities; likes imagination and the big picture.

first.name: 思考
first.description: 做决定时更依据逻辑、原则和客观分析。

second.name: 情感
second.description: 做决定时更考虑价值观、人的感受和对关系的影响。

first.name: Thinking
first.description: Decides more on the basis of logic, principles and objective analysis.

second.name: Feeling
second.description: Decides with more weight on values, people's feelings and effects on relationships.

first.name: 判断
first.description: 喜欢计划、有序和尽早确定，享受把事情完成的感觉。

second.name: 感知
second.description: 喜欢灵活、开放和随机应变，享受保留选择的余地。

first.name: Judging
first.description: Prefers plans, order and settling things early; enjoys finishing.

second.name: Perceiving
second.description: Prefers flexibility, openness and adapting as things come; enjoys keeping options open.
